questions.stem: 在借用異國文化元素時，許多人只看到他們想看到的，卻忽略了背後的意義。
questions.answer: When borrowing elements from foreign cultures, many people see only what they want to see and overlook the meaning behind them.
accepted_answers: When borrowing elements of other cultures, many people only see what they want to see but ignore the meanings behind them.
While borrowing cultural elements from other countries, many people see only what they wish to see, ignoring the meaning behind them.

questions.stem: 在文化符號被用來促銷的時代，對一般消費者來說，要分辨欣賞與挪用（appropriation）並不容易。
questions.answer: In an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products, it is not easy for ordinary consumers to tell appreciation from appropriation.
accepted_answers: In an era when cultural symbols are used for marketing, it is not easy for average consumers to tell the difference between appreciation and appropriation.
In an age where cultural symbols are used to sell products, it is hard for ordinary consumers to distinguish appreciation from appropriation.

patterns: 虛主詞 It＋形容詞＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「在借用…時」的主詞就是後面的「許多人」，英文用連接詞＋分詞 When borrowing elements from foreign cultures,（主動借用，用現在分詞）。「他們想看到的」沒有接名詞，表示「他們想看到的東西」，用 what 名詞子句 what they want to see，what 本身就是 the thing(s) that，前面不要再加 the thing。「卻忽略了背後的意義」和 see 對等，用 and／but overlook（或 ignore）the meaning behind them，描述普遍現象用現在式。
evidence: 在借用異國文化元素時
1.strategy_zh: 「在…時」且主詞相同→When + V-ing；「…的」後面沒有名詞→what 子句。
hints: 切成四段：在借用異國文化元素時／許多人只看到／他們想看到的／卻忽略了背後的意義
標的詞彙：borrow（借用）、element（元素）、foreign（外國的）、culture（文化）、only（只）、see（看到）、want（想要）、overlook（忽略，也可用 ignore）、meaning（意義）、behind（在…背後）
句型框架：When + V-ing …, S + see only + what + S + want to see + and overlook + N

2.explanation_zh: 「在文化符號被用來促銷的時代」修飾「時代」的子句很長，英文用關係副詞 when 放在名詞後面：In an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products,（符號是「被」用來促銷，用被動）。「對一般消費者來說，要分辨…並不容易」用虛主詞句 it is not easy for ordinary consumers to tell …（for + 人 + to VR），不要寫成 ordinary consumers are not easy to …。「分辨 A 與 B」是 tell A from B，也可以寫 distinguish A from B 或 tell the difference between A and B。
evidence: 在文化符號被用來促銷的時代
要分辨欣賞與挪用（appropriation）並不容易
2.strategy_zh: 「在…的時代／地方」→ an age when／a place where；「要…不容易」→ It is not easy (for 人) to VR。
hints: 切成四段：在文化符號被用來促銷的時代／對一般消費者來說／要分辨欣賞與挪用／並不容易
標的詞彙：age（時代）、culture（文化）、symbol（符號）、use（使用）、promote（促銷）、ordinary（一般的）、consumer（消費者）、tell（分辨）、appreciation（欣賞）、easy（容易的）
句型框架：In an age when + S + V …, it is not easy for + N + to tell A from B

traps.zh: 在借用異國文化元素時
traps.literal_error: When borrow elements from foreign cultures, many people …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「在借用…時」省略了主詞；英文省略主詞時要寫成連接詞＋分詞 When borrowing …，而且省略的主詞必須和主要子句的 many people 相同。
「背後的意義」是抽象名詞片語，英文是 the meaning behind them；「背後」不要直譯成形容詞 back。

bonus.text: When borrowing elements from foreign cultures, many people see only what they wish to see, turning a blind eye to the meaning behind them.
bonus.explanation_zh: turn a blind eye to（視而不見）是生動的慣用語，用分詞 turning 帶出「忽略」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在借用…時」和後面的「許多人」是同一個主詞，英文省略主詞寫成 When borrowing …；「他們想看到的」沒有名詞中心語，用 what 名詞子句 what they want to see 當 see 的受詞；「背後的意義」寫成 the meaning behind them。
1.notes_zh: 第 3 部分寫成 the things (that) they want to see 雖然意思相同，但沒有用到 what 子句，不在可接受寫法內。第 4 部分用 and／but 連接 overlook／ignore，或用分詞 ignoring／overlooking 都可以。寫成 When people borrow …, many of them … 是完整的副詞子句，沒有用到連接詞＋分詞，不在可接受寫法內。

common_errors.right: In an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products
common_errors.explanation_zh: 文化符號是「被」用來促銷，要用被動 are used to VR。

common_errors.wrong: In cultural symbols are used to promote products age
common_errors.right: In an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products
common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾「時代」的子句很長，英文要放在名詞後面，用 In an age when …。

common_errors.explanation_zh: 虛主詞句 it is + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to VR，「對…來說」用 for。
consumer 是可數名詞，泛指一般消費者用複數 consumers（或 the ordinary consumer）。

和 appropriation 對等的要是名詞 appreciation，不能用動詞 appreciate。

traps.zh: 在文化符號被用來促銷的時代
traps.literal_error: In cultural symbols are used to promote products age, …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「在…的時代」把很長的修飾語放在「時代」前面；英文要寫成 In an age when + 子句，關係副詞 when 引導的子句放在名詞後面。

traps.literal_error: Ordinary consumers are not easy to tell appreciation from appropriation.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文以「要分辨…」這個動作為主題，英文要用虛主詞 it is not easy for … to VR；寫成 consumers are not easy 會變成「消費者不容易相處」。

bonus.text: Never has it been harder for ordinary consumers to tell appreciation from appropriation than in an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products.
bonus.explanation_zh: 否定副詞 Never 置首倒裝（Never has it been …），再接比較級，強調「這個時代最難分辨」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「在…的時代」英文寫成 In an age when …，關係副詞 when 引導的子句放在 age 後面；「要分辨…並不容易」中文以動作當主題，英文用虛主詞句 it is not easy for … to VR；「分辨 A 與 B」是 tell A from B。
2.notes_zh: 第 1 部分寫 In an era when、In an age where 或 In an age in which 都可以（都是修飾「時代」的關係詞）。「被用來促銷」寫 are used to promote／sell／market products 或 are used for marketing 都可以。第 4 部分 it is not easy 也可寫 it is hard／difficult。寫成 ordinary consumers find it hard to … 是虛受詞句，沒有用到虛主詞 It is … to VR，不在可接受寫法內。

1.translation: When borrowing elements from foreign cultures, many people see only what they want to see but ignore the meaning behind them.
1.explanation_zh: 「在借用…時」用 When + V-ing 的簡化副詞子句；「他們想看到的」用名詞子句 what they want to see；「卻忽略」用 but ignore；them 指前面的文化元素。

2.translation: In an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products, it is not easy for ordinary consumers to distinguish between appreciation and appropriation.
2.explanation_zh: 「在…的時代」用 In an age when …；「對一般消費者來說，要…並不容易」用 it is not easy for … to …；「分辨 A 與 B」用 distinguish between A and B；「促銷」補出受詞 promote products 較自然。

1.translation: When borrowing elements from foreign cultures, many people see only what they want to see and ignore the meaning behind them.
1.explanation_zh: 「在借用……時」用 When + V-ing 的省略副詞子句；「只看到他們想看到的」用 see only what they want to see；「卻忽略了背後的意義」用 and ignore the meaning behind them。

2.translation: In an age when cultural symbols are used to promote products, it is not easy for ordinary consumers to tell appreciation from appropriation.
2.explanation_zh: 「在……的時代」用 In an age when ...；「被用來促銷」用 be used to promote products；「對一般消費者來說，要……並不容易」用虛主詞 it is not easy for ordinary consumers to ...；「分辨 A 與 B」用 tell A from B。
